title: A fix round's change list can give a page another id: the page is renamed and every place the plan names it follows
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: {page: X, field: 'id', with: Y} renames page X to Y everywhere the plan names it; a later change naming Y applies; a whole page given under Y with its decision renames then replaces it; a list of renames only applies.
Renaming to an id another page has, or a 'whole page' that is no page (no decision), is still refused.
With valid changes applied one by one, the rename counts as applied and a rejected change keeps its index in the list the planner sent.

tests: a page given a new id is renamed, and every place the plan names it follows
with valid changes applied one by one, a rename counts as applied and a rejected change keeps its own index
an edit at a path that is not there, or at an id, is refused and nothing is applied
